description:
A Digital Art Book and Soundtrack App featuring 134 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, monsters, and development materials. Enjoy all 56 music tracks from Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game.
name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Art Book and Soundtrack
